subject.title: fix(codex): normalize raw plugin payloads in dynamic tool bridge (fixes #97913) (AI-assisted)

question: Which open raw-payload normalization branch should become the canonical landing path after the serialization and proof blockers are addressed?
rationale: Two open PRs target the same canonical Codex dynamic-tool crash, and automation cannot safely choose a branch while this PR still has a correctness finding and both paths are proof-gated.

options.title: Repair this branch

options.title: Consolidate on the sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 if maintainers prefer that broader normalization shape after it is made clean, proof-backed, and reviewable.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Hold both PRs until a maintainer specifies the exact bridge-boundary contract and proof requirement.

recommendation.title: Repair this branch
